The best place to spend an evening in Da Nang
Feb 2026 • Couples
This place is fantastic. The owner and staff are so friendly. 

We found them by trying to find a ‘sports bar’ for the football (which they do show), but the place is a lot more than that. Great atmosphere. Relaxed. A good range of beers wines and cocktails. We ate here and didn’t regret it. Live music in one of the rooms at the front. The best bar we found on our extensive travels around Da Nang.

Westerner or not. Well worth a visit
